risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain for d.yilmaz@aegean.edu. Phishing lure from lookalike domain aegean-edu.co was delivered (F5, 0.8) and clicked (F8, 0.7), followed by MFA fatigue — 7 denied pushes then one approval from 185.220.101.7 (F3, 0.9). The same IP then performed bulk SIS access (38 events in 60 min, F1, 0.85). Persistence/exfiltration is confirmed via an API-created inbox forwarding rule to d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com (F6, 0.8). Corroborated by suspicious NL ASN sign-ins outside baseline (F4, 0.75) and impossible travel (F2, 0.7). The password-spray claim was correctly rejected as shared-egress background noise. Verified evidence across initial access, MFA bypass, data access, and persistence meets the contain threshold.
